title: Noisy One-Bullet Duel Value
body_html:
Noisy One-Bullet Duel Value

In the noisy duel where each player has one bullet and the kill probabilities $p_1,p_2:[0,1]\to[0,1]$ are strictly increasing continuous functions with $p_1(0)=p_2(0)=0$ and $p_1(1)=p_2(1)=1$, the game has a value in pure strategies.

The optimal pure strategy of each player is to shoot at the unique time $t_0$ satisfying $$ p_1(t_0)+p_2(t_0)=1. $$
